## Summary / 贡献摘要

Describe the research problem your plugin addresses and what this PR adds or changes.
简要说明插件解决什么科研问题，以及本次新增或修改的内容。

- Related issue, if any / 关联 Issue（如有）：
- New plugin or update / 新增或更新：

## Plugin Information / 插件信息

| Item / 项目 | Details / 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| Name / 插件名称 | |
| Plugin ID / 插件标识 | |
| Version / 插件版本 | |
| Author / 作者 | |
| License / 许可证 | |
| Supported ScholarSeed versions / 支持的书深版本 | |

## Requirements and Access / 运行条件与访问范围

Describe dependencies, models, external services, and setup instructions. Do not include actual credentials.
说明运行所需的依赖、模型、外部服务及配置方法，不要填写真实密钥。

- Dependencies and setup / 依赖与配置：
- File, command, or network access / 文件读写、命令执行或网络访问范围：
- Whether and what data is sent to external services / 是否向外部服务发送数据，发送哪些数据：

## Usage Example / 使用示例

Provide a shareable, reproducible example.
提供可公开分享、便于复现的示例。

- Installation and invocation / 安装与调用步骤：
- Example input / 示例输入：
- Expected result or output / 预期结果或产物：
- Actual output, screenshots, or demo, where applicable / 实际输出、截图或演示（如适用）：

## Validation / 验证记录

Report actual results and explicitly identify anything not tested. Use N/A for items that do not apply.
填写实际执行结果；未验证的部分请明确说明，不要仅填写“已测试”。不适用的项目填写 N/A。

- Environment: OS, ScholarSeed version, model / 验证环境：操作系统、书深版本、模型：
- Checks or tests performed and results / 执行的检查或测试及结果：
- Installation and real invocation in ScholarSeed / 是否在书深中完成安装及真实调用：
- Failure cases and known limitations / 异常场景与已知限制：
- Untested platforms or functionality / 未验证的平台或功能：

## Checklist / 提交自查

- [ ] I have read the contribution and plugin development guides. / 已阅读贡献指南和插件开发指南。
- [ ] Source files, installation instructions, and examples are included or linked. / 已提供或链接源码、安装说明及示例。
- [ ] Dependencies, access requirements, and external data transfers are disclosed. / 已说明依赖、访问要求及外部数据传输。
- [ ] No credentials, login caches, or private research data are included. / 未包含密钥、登录缓存或私有科研数据。
- [ ] Authorship, licenses, and applicable third-party notices are preserved. / 已保留作者信息、许可证及适用的第三方声明。
- [ ] Validation results and known limitations are accurately reported. / 已如实记录验证结果及已知限制。

## Publication Scope / 发布范围

Merging this PR accepts the source contribution; it does not automatically approve official evaluation, marketplace publication, or inclusion as a bundled plugin. Follow the applicable review and release process for publication.
PR 合并代表源码被接收，不等于插件已通过官方评测、自动上架技能市场或成为系统内置插件。正式发布仍走对应的审核与发布流程。
